note: CIMCO Edit 2026 Machine-Simulation navigation FSM. Screens are fingerprinted by the set of distinctive NAMED ribbon controls present in a `PrismCimcoUI.exe --op map` read (MSAA accName; the exe walks only controls present in the current ribbon state). Transitions are accDoDefaultAction invokes (--op invoke --name <X>). Control names + da values are the empirically-verified ribbon from spec CIMCO-SPINE2-LIVESIM-PLAN-2026-06-04 sec A/A7 (live --op map walked 1530 controls on DESKTOP-N7MI1VB). A screen matches when ALL its `discriminator` names are present AND none of its `discriminatorAbsent` names are present (mutual exclusion for superset states). report-toggle sub-path is a documented GAP (U-CIMCO-SIM-5/6 live probe).

editor.name: Editor tab (default landing)
editor.note: Default ribbon tab on launch. Backplot/Machine-Simulation controls are NOT yet active here. Discriminated by the Editor + NC Functions tab controls. (spec-derived; confirm live via record-screen before SIM-5.)

backplot.name: Backplot tab (Machine-Simulation surface, sim NOT yet engaged)
backplot.note: Backplot tab active, sim NOT engaged. spec sec A: Machine Simulation [ENABLED], Machine, Control + Control Type, Backplot (run), Backplot Setup, Backplot File present. discriminatorAbsent makes this MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with machine-sim-running (a superset state): the sim-engaged controls (Solid Model / Show Machine Origin) must be ABSENT from the walked tree, else this is the running state. Without this guard the FSM would mis-ID the running state as backplot and re-invoke Machine Simulation from an already-running state (2-reviewer-caught 2026-06-08). NOTE: MSAA may walk DISABLED controls by name; U-CIMCO-SIM-5 must confirm Solid Model is ABSENT-from-tree (not merely greyed) when not engaged.

machine-sim-running.name: Machine Simulation engaged (3D sim loaded -- SUPERSET of backplot)
machine-sim-running.note: Sim engine loaded (CIMCO grows ~388 MB; spec sec A2). SUPERSET of backplot -- keeps the Backplot-tab controls AND adds Solid Model / Show Machine Origin. Discriminator INCLUDES Machine Simulation (shared) plus the two sim-only controls, so a running ribbon matches HERE and is excluded from backplot by backplot.discriminatorAbsent. spec sec A: Solid Model / Stock Compare / Tool / axis-kinematics indicators DISABLED until a machine is loaded / sim runs. The report grid (LINE/TYPE/DESCRIPTION/ACTION) lives in this state; reading it is U-CIMCO-SIM-6.

transitions.label: Switch to the Backplot ribbon tab
transitions.note: spec sec A7: Backplot (pagetab, da=Switch). Drive flow Backplot-tab -> Machine-Simulation -> run confirmed via UIA InvokePattern (sec A2) + re-confirmed via MSAA accDoDefaultAction (sec A7).

transitions.label: Engage Machine Simulation (loads the 3D sim engine in-process)
transitions.note: spec sec A7: Machine Simulation (pushbutton, da=Click, path XTPMainFrame>xtpBarTop>...>The Ribbon). sec A2: sim is IN-PROCESS (does NOT spawn CIMCOSimulation.exe); CIMCO grows ~388 MB. accDoDefaultAction CAN block on a modal (sec A7 8s watchdog) -- the orchestrator handles the modal out-of-band; blocked is NEVER a clearance signal.

gaps: backplot -> Backplot Setup dialog -> enable 'Check collision and limit errors' / 'Report errors' / 'Stop Conditions': spec sec A2 -- report toggles are NOT top-level ribbon controls; they live in a Backplot Setup dialog/dropdown. Exact control path resolved by U-CIMCO-SIM-5/6 live dialog dump.

machine-sim-running -> read Simulation Report grid (LINE/TYPE/DESCRIPTION/ACTION): the verdict surface. Read path is U-CIMCO-SIM-6 (PrismCimcoUI.exe --op read-report C# change + parseSimulationReport).
backplot -> Machine select / Control Type bind (load the mapped .mcfg + controller): U-CIMCO-SIM-4 machine-bind gate (Romeo supplies the per-machine .mcfg via chat-bus CIMCO-SPINE2-machine-bind).

VERIFY-LIVE (SIM-5): record-screen each of editor/backplot/machine-sim-running against a real --op map and confirm the spec-derived discriminator names (Configure Machine Type / Solid Model / Show Machine Origin / NC Functions) are actually present-and-realized, and that Solid Model is ABSENT-from-tree (not just greyed) in the backplot (not-engaged) state.
